address: 124 Ren'ai Street, Sanchong District, New Taipei, Taiwan
bio: Opening its doors in 1998, this tiny gem has stood the test of time. The short but sweet menu is packed with well-made small bites at competitive prices: gelatinous and flavoursome braised pork trotter, tender and juicy pork knuckle, and fatty and toothsome braised pork chitterlings. Dine-in customers can order bento boxes with a portion of meat, three sides and rice. Fans of spicy food should not miss the house-made anchovy chilli sauce.
